nom: Rael Miracle Patch Retinol Spot Cover

avis.texte: I had a whitehead or a milia… idk i was never officially diagnosed. But it was a stubborn white spot that didnt go away for over a year. I used this on/off for a few months until finally it started to shrink and then it completely went away!!!!!

I always end up getting patches that dont work or are for young perfect skin. These patches work on my big painful deep blemishes that nothing else helps with. even though they are completely invisible I like to sleep in them and when I wake up there is ahuge noticeable difference and my blemish generally doesnt hurt anymore!

These Rael retinol patches are awesome! I swear every single one I've used has removed a good amount of gunk, and my skin is never left feeling sensitive or irritated from the retinol (which I feared). I like using these on the really angry, under-the-skin blemishes, and they've helped make those blemishes less nightmare-ish!

I put one of these on before bed and woke up to a noticeably smaller, less angry-looking blemish. It stays on well overnight and helps keep me from picking at my skin. I love that it treats the breakout while protecting it at the same time.

I got these as a free gwp when buying some sheet masks from the brand and they got thrown in a drawer. One day I banged my hand on the door frame going in my closet for the millionth time because why not. There was a small half dime size red spot that didn't bleed nor did it go away over time. There was an esthetician on duty at Ulta when I went and she told me I need a retinol product and an exfoliant because I was not seeing any skin turnover to heal and also needed to get rid of the skin that was damaged. She made some good but expensive recommendations but not pushy, very helpful. I already used a honey, sweet almost oil, and brown sugar scrub I make myself for pennies and found these patches in the drawer with other ones that were only the kind for pimples. The day after I took the patch off my finger, all my skin under there looked completely rejuvenated. I did 2 patches a couple days apart and coupled it with the scrub. It worked! Doesn't even look like anything was ever there. Thank you Ulta for employing an esthetician and Rael for doing GWPs so we can become lifelong customers. Don't forget this isn't medical advice, I did what the licensed esthetician recommended, just without spending $95.

I did my skin care routine and then added those patches after moisturizing. When I tell you, I didn't even recognize the patch being on my face it blended in so well and then when I woke up, the incoming pimples was like no more or stopped them in their tracks. Love it!
Just stuck to my face, did literally nothing. Get the curology patches instead work a million tunes better and way cheaper

I was an avid used of mighty patch but I got these in one of the goodie bags and I am hooked. These work great and hide well under makeup. It comes with so many of them too for a much lower price. Love that you can see them working too
They stick well to my skin (unlike other brands) and help greatly with my pimples
These are my favorite patches. I've tried quite a few and these are always consistent. I know I'll wake up in the morning clear of a blemish. Will always repurchase.

Most pimple patches only work on whiteheads. This does that too, buuuuut it also significantly shrinks cystic type pimples and also reduces any pigmentation that may occur from the pimple! Ive been struggling with hormonal acne the last year since i turned 36, and i have tried probably 20+ different pimple patches and these are hands down the best!!! Dont sleep on these...!
I've tried other products but they honestly all seem to just work as cover ups. THIS actual helps : minimizing the pimple and reducing redness, my faves!!

When it comes to tackling breakouts, these pimple patches are my absolute favorite! I patch them on before bed, and by morning that pesky pimple is GONE. I've tried brands like Hero, Starface, and CeraVe, but nothing beats Rael patches. They're too good!!!

These patches have been a total game changer! If I catch a spot early, the retinol patches stop my hormonal pimples from fully developing after just 1–2 nights. I have sensitive skin and can sometimes react to retinol, but I haven't had any issues with these.

avis.titre: These patches are worth the hype!
avis.texte: I get occasional breakouts and these patches have been a lifesaver! After cleansing, I stick a patch on before I sleep and by morning, it's sucked out all the fluids with no irritation. I have sensitive, combination skin so I love that it's safe to use.
The Retinol Spot Cover cleared my stubborn acne overnight—hands-down the best patch in the world!
These are my favorite acne patches! I have tried so many brands and these are the best. I have sensitive skin and these don't cause any irritation!
These are my favorite acne patches! I've tried so many brands and these work the best. I have sensitive skin and these don't cause any irritation!

As a person woth prone acne skin yhat have tried A LOT of pinpla patches, THIS HAS COME TO BE ONE OF MY FAV, if njot my fav, OF ALL TIME! This needs to be talked about more! And the price?? JUST AMAZING PRODUCT, genuinely!

38 years old and dealing with hormonal acne after switching birth controls. These patches are the best spot treatment for those huge stubborn monster zits I have been getting on my chin. They are so effective. I have tried others that say they contain retinol, and I have tried some with microneedles. The microneedles really only work on regular acne for me. These are the only patches that work on my hormonal breakouts.

I NEVER leave reviews, but these little miracles are life changing. I've squeezed pimples since my teens, and while it does empty it (eventually), it leaves behind a red scar I have to cover for years to dollow. I'm in my mid-40s and still get the occasional whitehead. I wash my face and pop one of these on before bed and by morning, the pimple is flat and the pus has been 100% sucked out into the patch. You can literally see it inside. I'll never squeeze and scar again!

I love this product and it works amazingly as long as you don't put anything on your skin before applying it. I wasted 5 or 6 of them the first day I used them because I followed the directions and used moisturizer prior to applying. They all fell off before I even went to bed. I've now started applying them to clean dry bare skin and they stay on all night. They are now my favorite pimple patches. I have cystic acne and they really prevent them from getting out of hand. They are also reasonably priced compared to other brands.

I had a firm red pimple that has been there for a week. I finally bought these and I had it on 5 almost 6 hrs and it turned while. When I pulled it off the pus was coming out and it was smoother. Will definitely buy again
Absolutely loved it , I will definitely be purchasing more I was extremely impressed

Been using these for a week now on the same pimple as soon as it came out its been very stubborn and has not taken any puss yet. Glad i didnt pay full price for these the truly ones worked way better. Still wearing them waiting to see if it eventually works.

I love that this pimple patch combines hydrocolloid AND retinol—such a great duo! The patches adhere really well to the skin, but for the best results, make sure your skincare has fully dried before applying. They stay put all day or night. These are most effective on already-open pimples, as they absorb excess oils and "suck the yuck" in the best way possible. They're super easy to use, leave no sticky residue, and work so well that I've had to reapply after just a few hours because the patch was full. Gross, but also amazing!
Affordable and pretty effective. They do not hurt and so easy to take off.

This pimple patch contains hydrocolloid, ceramide NP, niacinamide and retinol. Easy to apply. Just place over pimple for at least 4-8 hours (or when turns white). I put them on when I go to bed and remove in the morning. When you remove them, they don't leave any sticky residue. My skin loves them. They are safe for sensitive skin. I put them on a pimple over night and woke up with my skin looking like nothing was there. I'm not sure how this does with cystic acne or a deep pimple as I've only used them on pustules.

I really liked the value of this product. You get a lot of patches that make this product worth it. It helps to make dark spots and other problem areas less visible. It's easy to use and didn't irritate my skin!

avis.titre: Great to shrink and help get rid of acne spots!
avis.texte: I used this product off and on for several weeks and I really liked how it kept my acne spots moisturized so that they didn't get crusty or scab over during the night. I also liked how they prevented the acne from forming a white head. These spots won't make your acne disappear overnight, but when used with the right face routine, they will definitely make your breakouts easier to manage.
This is exactly what I needed for that time of month. Helps with cystic acne as well!
I loved it actually made my pimple go away the next day. This brand will be a staple in my collection.
It is miracle like they named it. I always have pimples when I almost have a period. I used it last Friday, the pimples have gone the next day. I don't see any red spot or numbin on my face
These really work. I was really annoyed by this one pimple on my chin so I put one on overnight and the spot got smaller and it was less noticeable next morning.
I enjoyed trying the rael patches because they helped my spots heal up faster with less hyperpigmentation. I liked the size of it as well with many patches that lasted a while.
I don't know if I would buy these again. I prefer cream but they did make my skin nice

I've tried multiple pimple patches, including those from Hero, and I find these Miracle Patch Retinol Spot Covers very similar. I've used them on whiteheads and on pimples that I want to prevent, and they have been effective in both cases. Of course, it's not magic, but after about 2 days, my blemishes become practically nonexistent. I have oily skin, so I often have issues with patches not sticking well, but that hasn't been a problem with these. The quality is great—they stay put for 12+ hours without issues. Highly recommend!

This product was gifted to me by BzzAgent for my honest opinion. I have never tried a pimple patch that has medication infused in it and I really liked the way this worked. Normally it takes me 2-3 days for a white head to produce but when I used this patch on a new pimple, the next day I saw it shrinks instead of producing a white head. I have hormonal cystic acne and sometimes it takes forever for a spot to go away, these patches quickly flattened my pimples within a couple days every night wearing it.

I had a couple of darker spots on my face from blemishes. After using these patches for two nights in a row, I saw a HUGE improvement!! I received these as a sample, but I will definitely purchase them myself in the future. Love how the sheets of patches are so small too- they are super easy to throw in your makeup bag for a trip.

Hydrocolloid pimple patches are super helpful in a pinch for my hormonal acne and are oh-so satisfying to peel off the next morning to see all the white stuff. I love that these are medicated - not only do they work at sucking out gunk but they also have time-released ingredients to reduce redness and inflammation and help heal the angry skin. I also love how the edges stay secure all night because they are tapered. Wish they came in different sizes as I've seen in other brands, but the 12mm size they do come in covers most sized spots effectively! A bit pricey but I only use them periodically so they last a while!
My first time used this brand and it works so much better! I've been wearing them for a few hours and they remove so much gunk and make my acne less noticeable. These definitely do not slip off.
I prefer to use blemish patches overnight and these held up very well. No peeling off or migrating while i slept

I use these patches on clean, unlotioned skin. They adhere very well, are very thin and clear. I use them in the evening and night since they have retinol in them. I would recommend to a friend. I received these in exchange for my honest review.

I have received the Miracle Patch Advanced Strength Retinol Spot Cover from Bzzagent for free in exchange for my review. Upon 1st use overnight, I noticed my acne size reduced significantly, in the past, it would take at least 2 days to get to this size. The Retinol, Niacinamide and Ceramide ingredients in the spot cover play a key role in such fast healing process. I definitely noticed a difference compared to the other acne cover i was using in the past. 100% recommend to those with really stubborn acnes

Firstly I will say I got this product as a gift via buzz agent in return for my honest review, I am not completely sure what the price point is for this product. I will say it does work and seems to minimize pimples when used for the full duration. The first thing I noticed about it and liked was they are pretty discreet small patches that are not noticeable on the skin. The first use I put on during the daytime and no one said anything about it and matched my skin tone very well; they are somewhat translucent. The second time I wore them I followed the directions ans wore them over a stubborn pimple overnight and when I woke up the pimple was almost entirely gone and no longer white.

About once a week, I get a really painful under the skin spot that takes days to go away. I've never used a spot patch before, but I was really impressed by this one! I put it on before going to bed one night and in the morning, the spot was nearly gone. It wasn't fully gone but it wasn't painful at all in the morning. I also really loved the size as they weren't too big.

I actually really liked these, after going through my usual night routine and put a patch where needed. It's super easy to use and I felt as if they work for me and my daughter. She really liked them, I guess because as apposed to putting a cream or gel on a bump, this she can see and feels like it's working the whole time. I'm real glad I was able to try them.

These patches do what they say they do! I wore them overnight and did notice my active breakouts were a little smaller the next day. I can't attest to them lightening acne scars because that would take a little longer to really see the improvements. The only downside is they don't stick to the skin super well, a couple did fall off.

I have used other spot patches, and my biggest issue is that they leave residue that you can see under makeup the next day. The Miracle Patches didn't leave any residue. I didn't have many opportunities to use them, but I think they helped, and I like that they have retinol to help with skin renewal.
I really like this acne treatment. It clears up my acne so quickly, and it doesn't leave any dark marks behind. I'm so glad I found it.

The Rael Beauty Miracle Patch Advanced Strength Retinol Spot Cover works well for what it's meant to do. I don't really notice that it's very different from other pimple patches already out on the market. It does a good job of covering your pimples and drawing out the fluid and since it contains retinol and niacinamide I think my acne scarring or hyperpigmentation is less noticeable after the pimple is gone. I'm still getting some hyperpigmentation but it's not as bad as it probably would be without the patches.

avis.titre: Practical, with many like products on the market
avis.texte: I put this on two acne spots during that time of the month and where I found it most useful was in helping to keep my fingers off the lesions and giving some matte/natural coverage. I cant speak to the retinol effect but anecdotally left less post inflammatory hyperpigmentation

*received product in exchange for an honest opinion* So I've been waiting to review this for a few weeks because I wanted to leave a review that is actually helpful. I've been using these miracle patches at night before I go to bed. I wash my face and wait until it is dry, then I put the patches on any problem areas I have, which is quite a few. At first, I didn't notice a difference but I continued to use them & now I can say I see the change. It didn't completely erase my acne by the next morning, but I can say that by using it every night, the acne disappeared way quicker than if I didn't use them. I definitely recommend & I will be buying more as soon as I run out. Plus you can't even see them on your face, which is nice for me. You can see in the picture you can't even see where they are on my face & I have like 6 of them on. These are awesome!! 👍🏻🙂
This really helped with dark spots. It unclogged my pores and made My skin look refreshing and it is waterproof I liked that

I tried it on a couple different types of pimples. The ones that were about to turn red it made them flat and almost like they never happened. The one that was really angry and red calmed down quite a bit and was significantly flatter. The patches stay on very well. Easy to forget about them.

avis.titre: Fast-Acting Retinol Acne Patch for Stubborn Breakouts
avis.texte: I have thoroughly enjoyed using this product BECAUSE IT WORKS! The Rael Miracle Patch Advanced Strength Retinol Spot Cover offers a time-released treatment for stubborn acne, using ingredients like retinol, niacinamide, and ceramides to reduce redness, unclog pores, and soothe skin. It's effective in reducing pimple size and redness within hours, making it a strong option for overnight use. Its blend of soothing and acne-fighting components provides quick results, making it a great addition to any skincare routine for those dealing with breakouts.

I was so excited to try this Retinal Spot Cover because I think that it is a wonderful product. Unfortunately, it did not work for me. I have finished 2 sheets and still haven't seen any improvement with my sun spots. Those patches were really sticked to my face though and that was great. I just wished it worked for me.
I put the product over and dark spots I had on my face before I went to bed. After I woke up I removed them and washed my face as usual. I did not notice any huge differences.
Have been using these almost daily since I got them. They help heal problem areas quicker. They are sealed in packs of 12 so they don't dry out or lose any product. I love that.

i really enjoy these patches! they have good adhesive, and do not leave residue. They are not as noticeable as other patches i've used and reduce spots/pimples much quicker than the other brands i've tried.

This product says its for stubborn acne, which I definitely had. I have a reoccurring pimple in my eyebrow and it is super annoying. I used this patch and saw results in one night. I kept using it throughout the week and I think the pimple is finally healing! I feel like all the other times it would "go away" but I would still feel it. Now it is completely flat and the color is fading. I would say that these are really sticky, it did pull out a few of my brow hairs and it can leave behind residue if you leave it on too long, but I would say it is worth it!

I have tried dozens of spot cover patches and this one is truly impressive! The adhesive is strong, it stayed on my nose throughout the night and did not budge! Yet gentle enough that it doesn't tug at the skin when removing. The ingredients on the patch are very effective! The pimple was practically gone by the next day with no scarring!

avis.titre: I would def buy this product again
avis.texte: I really love how the patches contain retinol which helps to exfoliate and unclog my pores! And the niacinamide also helps to reduce appearance of acne scarring! I'm obsessed with these patches I would def get them again.

These patches do work like miracles. I had a nasty breakout on face as I have an acne prone skin. I applied the patch after cleaning and drying my face. I kept it on for almost 7-8 hours. It pulled out all the pus from the breakout as mentioned on the packaging. Next morning the breakout was looking much better and almost close to ve healed. I would definitely keep these handy.
I've used other pimple patches in the past. Wasn't really expecting anything different. I absolutely loved these patches. They were great. I highly recommend.

The Rael Miracle Patch Advanced Strength Retinol Spot Cover is an effective acne treatment patch, particularly for stubborn and hormonal pimples. It combines retinol, niacinamide, and ceramide to reduce redness, shrink pimples, and support skin healing. The hydrocolloid material helps draw out impurities while the patch remains securely in place overnight. It's gentle enough for sensitive skin, making it a reliable option for regular use on deeper blemishes. If you're struggling with hard-to-treat breakouts, this patch provides a quick and targeted solution.

avis.titre: Definitely going to buy this product!!!
avis.texte: I absolutely loved the miracle patch advanced strength retinol spot cover. I suffer from dark sun spots and after using this product for 3 days I have already noticed lighter sun spots. Before this product I was looking into laser treatments to remove the dark pigment spots on my face. This product saved me so much money. Can't wait to buy some !

I've used the regular pimple patches before, but I didn't know they had ones with retinol in them! These patches worked extremely well in reducing the size and redness of my pimples, and I'm so happy to know that I'm taking good care of my skin at the same time. I think these are an amazing value for the price as well. Very happy with these and I will be buying more!

The Rael Miracle Patch Advanced Strength Reticol Spot Cover has been pretty cool for me. I've used it on my pimples overnight, and by morning, it pulls out all the white stuff, which is so satisfying. The best part is that it doesn't leave behind any dark spots like some other treatments do. However, it doesn't seem to do much for older dark spots, but for fresh pimples, it works really well. I received this in exchange for my honest review and haven't tried for about 2 weeks.

avis.titre: A little too soon to tell
avis.texte: I've been using these patches for about a week. I haven't noticed any changes in my dark spots but I am hopefully. I will continue to use these patches and hopefully I can get rid of these stubborn dark spots.
It is made from retinol, I usually leave it on all night, and it works perfectly, I recommend it. They are 12 mm.

The Miracle Patch Advanced Strength Retinol Spot Cover patches are absolutely amazing! They worked incredibly well & were 100% worth the try! I put them on overnight (as the instructions state to do) & they did not move whatsoever. They sucked out all the gunk that was needed. I will be buying this product again & again! 10/10 recommendation to anyone who is interested in patches & the benefits they provide!

This is a great product for everyone who suffers from those stubborn spots. Very easy to apply no work involved. I used after my nightly skincare routine and woke up to the spots less noticeable. Great at unclogging your pores.

Easy to put on and go about your day! I have definitely seen improvement in my skin. As I do have breakouts whenever I have my monthly. Put the patch on at night and it flattens within morning! I would definitely recommend this product!

I've not had the best of luck with "pimple" patches. They seem to fall off my face or they'll stick but they're never there in the morning. But these patches were the best I've ever used. I applied them over spots that have been on my face for what seems like forever and those spots are now gone!! They stayed in place overnight and I got to peel them off in the morning. I would suggest putting them on first and then applying your skincare around them tho.

avis.titre: I would definitely buy this product again.
avis.texte: I used this Real Miracle Patch for the first time and I love it, this works really well on my pimples. I like that it has retinol and they stay in place overnight with no irritation. I will definitely buy it again.
My skin is so much clearer. These patches hide blemishes and heal them quick. They are definitely worth trying.

As someone who deals with breakouts and uneven skin texture/acne scars, I was curious to see how these patches would work for me. Each patch is just the right size to cover blemishes without being obvious. Applying them was simple; I cleansed my face and placed a patch on my trouble spot. They stick well even after toner, serum/moisturizer (I allowed it to sit for about 10 minutes before I applied the patch). It also held overnight. I love that they're transparent, so I didn't feel weird wearing them during the day. After just one night, I noticed a big reduction in redness and swelling, and my skin felt smoother by morning. I think it's so brilliant to incorporate retinol into these. So if you're looking for an effective spot treatment that really works, I highly recommend these patches. They work way better than the other ones I used to use. I'm not sure why the box doesn't state how many are in each package, but there's 48 patches in each one. You're welcome.

So this is my first time trying these types of patches. I have hormonal acne around that time of the month and these work well to control those flare ups. The adhesion is great and the patch is thin enough that you don't feel it on your face. When you take the patch off you can see that a lot gunk has been extracted from your skin! My acne went away within two applications of the patch so i definitely recommend!!

It is really amazing to see how much pus and oil these patches will draw out just overnight! They stayed on my face all night and didn't irritate my skin at all. I never have to worry about my stubborn acne again. Super affordable too!!
I love these pimple patches. After doing my skincare at night, I apply the patches to my healing pimples and dark spots. After one to two uses, my scars have faded and my skin tone looks more even.

Thank you Rael for the free Miracle Patch Advanced Strength Retinol Spot Cover sample. I love using retinoid/retinol products. I get prescription strength tretinoin from my dermatologist, but sometimes I get lazy and skip my routine. Whenever I do, I always end up paying for it and acne starts to form. I love these pimple patches for that quick little spot treatment.

avis.titre: This is gonna be on my subscription list!
avis.texte: This product was great. There are a lot of similar products on the market, but this one has for sure results. I put it on a pimple that I had previously popped and the next day, It was reduced, and the discoloration was gone by over 80%. It was in a miracle.

The Rael Beauty Miracle Patches are absolutely amazing! Never before have I used a product that is so effective in such a small amount of time! After washing my face, I put one of these patches on a blemish and left it overnight. By the following morning that blemish was hardly noticeable! In my opinion, there is not one person out there that would regret purchasing these amazing little dots! I would highly recommend this product.

I've used several brands of pimple patches before and this is one of my favorites. The kind I tried before this one didn't stick after I put on my skincare and would just slide off. These patches stick even on top of my skincare and made my pimple come to the surface. It stayed on all night and I even wore it in the morning and it was barely noticeable bc it matches my skin color. I would repurchase.

I recently tried the Miracle Advanced Strength Retinol Cover patches, and I was pleasantly surprised by their performance. The patches adhered well to my skin and stayed in place, which is often a concern with similar products. They blended seamlessly, making them easy to incorporate into my skincare routine without feeling bulky. After a few uses, I noticed a slight reduction in redness, which was encouraging. While the results weren't drastic, they were definitely noticeable, and I appreciated the gentle approach. Overall, these patches are a great option for anyone looking to add a bit of retinol into their regimen without irritation. I would recommend them for those seeking subtle improvements in their skin tone.

The spot cover was easy to apply and remove. I used the spot cover overnight and throughout the next morning. After removing the cover, my spot was noticeably smaller and less red. Throughout the day the spot continued to shrink in size. I recommend these spot covers for reducing the size of spots with no pain and little effort.

I love these patches! these will now be my go to better than any other retinol patch products! they stick so well and aren't super thin like the other patches. And so far i've been seeing improvement with my dark spots! Im telling all my friends and family about these great patches!

The Spot Cover is an effective and easy-to-use solution for treating blemishes, significantly reducing redness and size overnight. The patches stay in place well and are discreet enough to wear during the day.
I recently tried this miracle patches by Rae's Beaty and o loved hike discrete they are. Nobody noticed I had them and I noticed results as soon as I used them.

I did receive this free from bzzagent for my honest review and I have to say this product The advance strength retinol spot cover patch works so good I've tried other patches before and none of them preforms as good as this, definitely recommend this to all skintype people.

I am prone to acne scarring and hyperpigmentation so I decided to try these patches. They reduce the persistent swelling caused some pimples. These patches also reduces the temporary redness. However, it did not do much to reduce the pigmentation left behind by acne. I really wish they had micro darts so that the retinol could penetrate and reduce pigmentation.

avis.titre: Works just as it attends to!
avis.texte: The **Miracle Patch Advanced Strength Retinol Spot Cover** has been a game changer for me. I've used it overnight on stubborn blemishes, and by morning, the redness and swelling are noticeably reduced. The retinol is a nice bonus, and the patch stays put without irritating my skin. It's also nearly invisible, so I can wear it during the day too. Highly recommend if you need an effective spot treatment!
Very impressed with this type of pimple patch. They're nearly invisible & really help heal time and protect the problem area. Great value and super effective!!
Miracle patch advanced strength retinol spot cover works great for small blemishes, almost vanishes over night. I'd highly recommend this product

I love these! They not only cover blemishes but also work to reduce their appearance over night! You can barely see them on during the day as well. After using them, I noticed a significant reduction in the size and redness of my pimples. Plus, they don't irritate my sensitive skin. They're a must-have in any skincare routine!
